About the project

Comic energy, original responsibility.

Design direction

Panelverse studies the visual grammar of superhero comics: strong silhouettes, captions, panels, halftone texture, dramatic scale and energetic transitions. The interface remains original and prioritises readability, accessibility and mobile performance.

WordPress manages characters and stories, Elementor structures pages and reusable content, and a static export powers the GitHub Pages deployment.

This independent student project is not affiliated with Marvel Entertainment or any other comics publisher.
